haiku_1.text:
Added:
- 1.5s invulnerability after start or restart, with the player sprite flickering
- Hazards fade in over 0.8s and can't hurt the player until fully visible
- Violet shield orbs appear after 8s and grant a 4-second shield
- Shield smashes hazards on contact for +3 points
- Quick pickups within 1.5s chain into a combo
- Score multiplier rises with the combo, up to x4
- Floating score popups (+N, SHIELD)
- On-screen COMBO and SHIELD indicators, with a shield timer bar
- Seekers enter from off-screen edges
- Esc now pauses and resumes, in addition to P
- Game over and win screens show orbs collected and hazards smashed
- New sounds for shield pickup and hazard smashing, and collect pitch rises with the combo
- Orbs no longer spawn next to hazards

Removed:
- Instant lethal contact with hazards at any time (now delayed by fade-in and blocked by grace or shield)

sonnet_6.text:
No features or mechanics were added or removed. The diff only changes tuning values and HUD layout:

- Starting lives went from 3 to 4.
- Regular orbs last 12 seconds instead of 10.
- The early-game orb lifetime bonus applies until 25 seconds instead of 20.
- Opening hazards: 2 queued at 1.5s and 2.7s, instead of 3 at 0.3s, 0.7s, and 1.1s.
- Hazard spawn interval starts at 3.6s instead of 3.2s, with a 0.8s floor instead of 0.7s.
- HUD: the lives row moved up slightly, and the dash cooldown bar and its label moved down.
